pieces.title: The sleepers
pieces.caption: The four pages asleep in the palace today, their heroes greyed, and the four ways in that can wake one. *What is real and what is a choice:* Asleep by the rite's own precondition: stage dormant or composting, or type spore. Map build of 2026-11-09. *Leaking in:* 1 from 2, JSUI, Symbiotic Skills, Walk That Weaves.

challenge.by: challenger · light round, batch C (sheets built from heroes and avatars) · read-only dispatch

verdicts.why: True to the page on every point and it gives what the text cannot: the names and greyed faces of the pages the rite exists for. The four ways in are the Contract's, "only one rite wakes them" is the page's sentence. Notes: the caption says "today" and will outlive the day, so it should carry the date; "he grants a steward's request" has no "he" in its box;
